verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only generic 'real-time evaluation' via webhooks (helicone-docs-23) and general REST/query APIs (helicone-docs-15, helicone-docs-32), but nothing documenting a dataset-creation API, an eval-run trigger endpoint, or a workflow for an agent to programmatically create a dataset and read back eval results. Missing for 10: dataset creation API/SDK docs, eval run trigger endpoint, structured results retrieval, any agent-facing example of this end-to-end flow.
